"""Fixed-horizon retention pilots. Supervised arms and separately labelled fresh PG.

The line search is a finite empirical function constraint, not a safety proof.
Adam moments come from the full proposal when a scaled parameter step is kept;
rejection restores both Actor and Adam. All such attempts are counted.

 for g in opt.param_groups:g['lr']=p['rl_lr'] if p['arm']=='rl' else p['fit_lr']

 pred=q.branch(packed)[0];tasks=[]

  loc=(g['base']+pred[:len(g['n']),i]-g['reference'])[g['mask']];t=g['target'][g['mask']]
  per=(loc-t).square().mean(-1) if domain=='raw' else P.action_loss(loc,t.clamp(-1,1)).mean(-1)

def protection(q,data,packed):

 for i,g in enumerate(data):
  if g['kind']!='recovery':continue
  loc=(g['base']+pred[:len(g['n']),i]-g['reference'])[g['mask']];target=g['target'][g['mask']]
  raw=torch.maximum(raw,(loc-target).abs().max());command=torch.maximum(command,(loc.clamp(-1,1)-target.clamp(-1,1)).abs().max())

"""RAM-only archive after every science writer is stopped; no training imports."""
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import time

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT=ROOT/'stage/runs/t606_offline_retention_night'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('_t606_archive',ROOT/'stage/experiments/t493_wide8_night/transport.py')
A=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(A)


def stopped():
    j=json.loads((OUT/'SEALED.json').read_text())
    assert j['all_scientific_processes_stopped']
    assert all(not Path('/proc',str(i)).exists() for i in j['scientific_pids'])


def main():
    A.OLD.install();T=A.OLD.T
    import urllib.request
    T.B.OPENER=urllib.request.build_opener()
    if sys.argv[1]=='source_sync':
        import sync_source
        sync_source.main();return
    assert sys.argv[1]=='T606';stopped();A.stopped=stopped
    original=T.B.write
    def write(path,value):
        if Path(path).name=='source_manifest_T606.json':
            value=dict(value,scope='Ended Stage T606 offline finite retention relay; raw/command/freshPG arms with full audits; frozen paired diagnostics separate; no global promotion, no new RL')
        return original(path,value)
    T.B.write=write
    p=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text())
    release=T.B.api('GET','releases/tags/stage-eight-only-2026-11-11')
    files=sorted(f for f in OUT.rglob('*') if f.is_file() and f.name!='driver.log' and f.suffix not in ['.lock','.pyc','.partial'])
    deadline=min(time.time()+p['transport_seconds']-10,p['absolute_all_stop']-30)
    r=A.archive('T606',files,release,deadline,T)
    stopped();assert r['state']=='FULL_REMOTE_READBACK_AND_EVERY_MEMBER_SHA_VERIFIED'
    print('T606_FULL_RAW_BACKUP_PASS',flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()
